checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_BOQ event group with no line items is allowed only when the workspace flag is on
checkResults.expectedResult: In the flag-OFF workspace: HTTP 422 with error code 101 from render_error_json(101) unless Current.workspace.boq_in_erfx_allowed?. In the flag-ON workspace the same payload yields HTTP 200 and EventGroups::CreateService#create_line_items returns [] early because event_group.boq_based_rfx? is true and @line_items is blank.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with config.boq_based_rfx true and no line_items in the flag-ON workspace and assert HTTP 200 with zero line items created.
2. Repeat the identical POST in the flag-OFF workspace.
3. Assert the flag-OFF call is refused with a numeric error code and creates nothing.
checkResults.preconditions: Run the same payload against two workspaces: one with CustomConfiguration boq_in_erfx_allowed enabled and one without.
checkResults.verdict: ACCEPTED input that should have been rejected (HTTP 200)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_BOQ event group rejected when status is missing even with the BOQ flag set
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 ('Insufficient parameters'). The params[:status].blank? guard is the FIRST statement in Api::EventGroupsController#create and runs before the boq_based_rfx branch, so the BOQ flag cannot bypass it.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with config.boq_based_rfx true, a title, but no status field.
2. Assert HTTP 422 with a numeric error code.
3. Assert no event_groups row is created.
checkResults.preconditions: Workspace has boq_in_erfx_allowed enabled, so the BOQ branch is reachable.
checkResults.verdict: correctly rejected (422: Insufficient parameters)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_BOQ flag sent as the string true with an oversized nested config
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx. Hazard: the controller does boq_based_rfx = params.dig('config','boq_based_rfx') || false, so the STRING 'true' is truthy in Ruby and takes the BOQ branch, while EventGroup#boq_based_rfx? later returns the string 'true' rather than a boolean. Assert consistent behaviour and that no line-items requirement is bypassed by an unintended truthy value.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with config.boq_based_rfx as the string 'true' plus a deeply nested extra key.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx or a 200 where boq_based_rfx? evaluates consistently.
3. Assert the jsonb config column round-trips without truncation and never causes a 500.
checkResults.preconditions: Workspace has boq_in_erfx_allowed enabled; no line_items are sent.
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — served the request (HTTP 200)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Create an event group with an explicit empty config object
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 200. event_group.config is persisted as {} and EventGroup#boq_based_rfx? returns false via config&.dig('boq_based_rfx') || false, so the non-BOQ line_items requirement branch applies.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with config set to an empty object plus a valid line item.
2. Assert HTTP 200.
3. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} and assert boq_based_rfx resolves to false.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; {{productUuid}} active in the workspace.
checkResults.verdict: accepted, as expected (HTTP 200)

steps: 1. Confirm boq_in_erfx_allowed is off for the workspace.
2. POST /event_groups with config.boq_based_rfx true and no line items.
3. Assert HTTP 422 with a numeric error code and no EventGroup created.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser in a workspace where CustomConfiguration boq_in_erfx_allowed is NOT set, so Company#boq_in_erfx_allowed? returns false.
checkResults.verdict: ACCEPTED input that should have been rejected (HTTP 200)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Config sent as a string instead of an object must not crash create
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx. params.dig('config','boq_based_rfx') on a String raises TypeError in Ruby, so the controller must guard the type and return HTTP 422 with a numeric error code rather than crashing before authorize EventGroup.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with config as the string 'boq_based_rfx=true'.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx and never a 500.
3. Assert no EventGroup is persisted with a malformed jsonb config column.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; {{productUuid}} active.
checkResults.verdict: server error 500 — a 5xx is always a defect

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Non-existent product_uuid on line item must not crash event group creation
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx expected (422 with a numeric code). Risk being probed: get_details_for_event_group_line_items does products.find { ... } then dereferences product.id, so an unmatched product would raise NoMethodError on nil and surface as 500. Either way the transaction must roll back and leave zero event_groups rows.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a line item whose product_uuid decodes to an id with no matching active Product.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx and NOT a 500.
3. Assert no partially-created EventGroup is left behind, since create_line_items runs inside the ActiveRecord::Base.transaction.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser. The decoded product id does not exist, or exists but is not Product.active in this workspace.
checkResults.verdict: server error 500 — a 5xx is always a defect

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Negative and non-numeric quantities must not be silently coerced into a valid event
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx. Documented hazard: the helper uses quantity[:value].to_f, so 'ten'.to_f becomes 0.0 and silently flips is_rate_only to true, while -5 survives as -5.0. A negative or silently rate-only line item must be refused with a numeric error code rather than persisted.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with two line items: one with quantity value -5 and one with quantity value 'ten'.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx, or if accepted, assert the stored quantities are never negative.
3. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items and inspect the persisted quantity values.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; {{productUuid}} and {{productQualityUuid}} are active.
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — served the request (HTTP 200)

checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx and no data leak. Expected outcome is HTTP 422 with a numeric error code; the created EventGroup (if any) must carry company_id = Current.workspace.id only and must not expose the foreign product's name or quality params in meta_data.
steps: 1. Obtain a product uuid owned by a different tenant.

checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated as a purchaser of company A. {{productUuid}} is a Product that belongs to company B and is not visible to company A.
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — served the request (HTTP 200)
